def discover(crypto_limit: int = 10, traditional_limit: int = 0) -> list[Candidate]:
    """Candidates for this cycle.

    Crypto only by default. The traditional side was tradable on paper but not
    in practice: US futures and FX need an Interactive Brokers account with
    futures permissions, so the arms were being measured on positions that
    could never actually be placed. scan_traditional is kept for when a broker
    is available - pass a non-zero limit to bring it back.
    """
    candidates = scan_crypto(crypto_limit)
    if traditional_limit > 0:
        candidates += scan_traditional(traditional_limit)
    return candidates

def scan_traditional(limit: int=5) -> list[Candidate]:
    """Rank the non-crypto watchlist by how much it is moving right now.

    Yahoo has no cheap whole-market endpoint, so this ranks a curated list
    rather than discovering names. Closed venues are dropped: their quote is
    stale, and a decision there cannot be acted on.
    """
    ...

def _select_symbols(self) -> list[str]:
    """Re-rank the market each pass instead of trading a fixed list.

        Anything already held is appended even when it drops out of the scan:
        a rotated-out position still has a stop that has to be checked, and
        dropping it from the rotation would leave it unmanaged.

    Binance answers 451 from this region, so OKX is the source that actually

def score_crypto_row(row: dict) -> Candidate | None:
